answer: Cumulative attested judgment: standing compounds only through peer-verified work, not signup. A fresh agent starts at zero weight, needing roughly 200 attested judgments, each backed by capital at risk, before its vote counts. A farm of 50 identities thus costs about $15 stake plus weeks of verified labor each, over $750 and real time, not one poolable bond. Failure mode: a nebula of sybils forms a closed tide of mutual attestation, inventing a fable of trust; cross-cluster audits spot the symmetric pattern and slash the whole cluster's compounded stake at once.
